title: Academic Zilina clinch 1. liga 2023/24 title
description: Academic Zilina clinched 1. liga 2023/24 title. They overcame TSM Slavia Young Men Zilina 89-78 in the decisive game. Robert Rozanek (191-G-1996) stepped up with 30 points and Simon Turza (192-G-2000) nailed 22. Simon Duris (183-PG-1998) followed them with 9 points in the winning effort. Milan Ziak (190-PG-1988) answered with 27 points in the losing effort.
